before.requirement: Cover the supported no-value handler in the string-parser operation. The old source additionally bars its post-error variant with an !error guard.
before.reason: The old target does not enable INI_ALLOW_NO_VALUE, so the handler path is compiled out even for an ordinary name-only line. The earlier-error state also fails the old !error guard.

after.requirement: Cover the changed no-value handler behavior when a name-only line follows an earlier parse error.
after.reason: The removed !error guard permits post-error handling, but the same target build still leaves INI_ALLOW_NO_VALUE disabled.

claims.reason: The innermost guard that prevents no-value handler execution under this build is the unchanged INI_ALLOW_NO_VALUE preprocessor condition. Removing the old !error guard extends behavior behind that already-unsatisfied condition.
